title: Inventory Intelligence
subtitle: Where inventory value sits, what moves, and what needs attention

timeSemantics.sales: Sales and movement: over the selected period. Changing the period does not recalculate past stock.

health.title: Stock movement health
health.method: Classification uses first receipt and last sale: “new” is under {{tooNew}} days since receipt; “fast” sold within {{recent}} days with at least {{units}} units in {{window}} days; “steady” sold within {{window}} days; “slow” is over {{established}} days since receipt with past sales but none recently; “stagnation candidate” is over {{established}} days since receipt and never sold.
health.slowHint: Has past sales but nothing recent
health.dead_candidateHint: Over 30 days since receipt and never sold
health.too_newHint: Received recently, not enough time to judge
health.unknown_ageHint: No receipt history, so its age cannot be determined
health.evaluatingHint: Products aged 14–30 days without enough history yet to judge slow movement

breakdown.unusableHint: This dimension has no real segmentation, so it cannot be analysed.
breakdown.unknownWarning: {{percent}} of the value has no value for this dimension.

matrix.title: Stock vs demand
matrix.method: Split on the period's own median stock and median sales, not fixed numbers. Stock is the current position; sales cover the selected period.
matrix.empty: Too few products to build a meaningful matrix.

deadCandidates.subtitle: Over 30 days since receipt with no sale at all

sizes.pickType: Choose a product type to see size analysis
sizes.pickTypeWhy: Size ranges are not comparable across types, so the analysis covers one type at a time.
sizes.notApplicableFor: Size analysis is not available for “{{productType}}”
sizes.notApplicableWhy: This type does not use comparable sizes, or its products are colour-only and one-size.
sizes.empty: No sizes to show for this type
sizes.emptyWhy: No sized stock or sales exist for this type right now.
sizes.scopeNote: Scoped to “{{productType}}”. Colour-only and one-size products are excluded.
sizes.summary: {{stock}} sizes in stock · {{missing}} existing size variants now out of stock

highlights.inventoryConcentration: {{percent}} of inventory value sits in {{count}} models.
highlights.deadCandidates: {{products}} models worth {{value}} are stagnation candidates ({{units}} units).
highlights.tooNewShare: {{percent}} of products do not yet have enough history to judge their movement ({{products}} products).
highlights.inventoryCoverage: Cost is known for only {{percent}} of stock, so inventory value is partial.
